claims.text: The minutes of Thursday 18 January 2018 record the oath of the Speaker, Lord Fakafanua, followed by 'Fakafuakava'i 'Eiki Palēmia'. The Prime Minister takes two oaths ('oku 2 'ene fuakavá): first as the Representative for Tongatapu 1, then as a Minister and Prime Minister. The first ends 'Ko au, Samuela 'Akilisi Pōhiva.'
claims.uncertainty: An oath before the Assembly, separate from the 2 January 2018 effective appointment and not a start date. The English rendering of the procedural sentence is this packet's reading.
